summary: Titanic victim and brother-in-law of architect Stanford White; John's 6th cousin 5x removed via Bull Smith.
bio: Route (6C5R): Bull Smith → Richard Jr. (2d) → Sarah Woodhull → Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull → Elizabeth Woodhull Nicoll → Eliza Nicoll Smith → Judge J. Lawrence Smith → James. Born 1856 in Smithtown; lived in Paris; travelled first class on the Titanic and died in the sinking in 1912; his body was not recovered. His sister Bessie married Stanford White. (Birthplace, Paris residence, first-class travel and body-not-recovered details come from the project's research-thread answer to John's question 'who was James Clinch Smith?' (section 1.4); the research notes record only 'died on the Titanic'.)
notable: Died in the sinking of RMS Titanic, 1912.
sources: Research-thread answer to John's question 'who was James Clinch Smith?' (section 1.4)
